import Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme
import Mathlib.Algebra.Category.Grp.Adjunctions

/-!
# The units presheaf of a scheme

For a scheme `X`, this file defines the presheaf `𝒪_X^*` of unit groups of the structure
sheaf on the small Zariski site (the poset `X.Opens`), valued in `CommGrpCat`, together
with the element-level interface used by the Čech `H¹` layer of the Picard group:

* restriction of a unit section along `V ≤ U` is `Units.map` of the ring-level restriction;
* pullback of a unit section along a morphism of schemes, packaged as
  `Scheme.Hom.unitsAppLE` (the unit-group analogue of `Scheme.Hom.appLE`), with the same
  composition/restriction calculus as `appLE`.

## Main declarations

* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.unitsPresheaf`: the units presheaf
  `X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat CommMonCat ⋙ CommMonCat.units`, a functor
  `(X.Opens)ᵒᵖ ⥤ CommGrpCat.{u}`.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.unitsPresheaf_map_apply`: restriction of unit sections,
  element form.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.unitsAppLE`: for `f : X ⟶ Y`, `V : Y.Opens`,
  `U ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ V`, the group homomorphism `Γ(Y, V)ˣ →* Γ(X, U)ˣ`.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.unitsAppLE_map`, `Scheme.Hom.map_unitsAppLE`,
  `Scheme.Hom.unitsAppLE_unitsAppLE`, `Scheme.id_unitsAppLE`: the calculus mirroring
  `appLE_map`, `map_appLE`, `appLE_comp_appLE` and `id_app` at the unit level.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Opposite

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

namespace Scheme

variable {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}}

/-- The units presheaf `𝒪_X^*` of a scheme `X`, on its small Zariski site: the composite
of the structure presheaf with the units functor, valued in commutative groups.

This is `abbrev` (reducible): the Čech layer constantly mixes sections typed through
`unitsPresheaf.obj` with sections typed `Γ(X, U)ˣ`, and rewriting across that boundary
requires the two to agree at instance transparency. -/
abbrev unitsPresheaf (X : Scheme.{u}) : (X.Opens)ᵒᵖ ⥤ CommGrpCat.{u} :=
  X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat CommMonCat ⋙ CommMonCat.units

lemma unitsPresheaf_obj (U : (X.Opens)ᵒᵖ) :
    X.unitsPresheaf.obj U = CommGrpCat.of Γ(X, unop U)ˣ :=
  rfl

lemma unitsPresheaf_map {U V : (X.Opens)ᵒᵖ} (i : U ⟶ V) :
    X.unitsPresheaf.map i = CommGrpCat.ofHom (Units.map (X.presheaf.map i).hom) :=
  rfl

/-- Element form of the restriction maps of the units presheaf. This is the interface
through which cocycle computations reach the `Units` API. -/
@[simp]
lemma unitsPresheaf_map_apply {U V : (X.Opens)ᵒᵖ} (i : U ⟶ V) (u : Γ(X, unop U)ˣ) :
    X.unitsPresheaf.map i u = Units.map (X.presheaf.map i).hom u :=
  rfl

/-- The composite with the forgetful functor to `GrpCat` (the shape consumed by
`CategoryTheory.PresheafOfGroups.OneCocycle`), element form. -/
@[simp]
lemma unitsPresheaf_forget₂_map_apply {U V : (X.Opens)ᵒᵖ} (i : U ⟶ V) (u : Γ(X, unop U)ˣ) :
    (X.unitsPresheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommGrpCat GrpCat).map i u
      = Units.map (X.presheaf.map i).hom u :=
  rfl

/-- Split form of `unitsPresheaf_forget₂_map_apply`: after `Functor.comp_map` has fired,
the restriction maps appear as `(forget₂ _ _).map (X.unitsPresheaf.map i)`. -/
@[simp]
lemma forget₂_map_unitsPresheaf_map_apply {U V : (X.Opens)ᵒᵖ} (i : U ⟶ V)
    (u : Γ(X, unop U)ˣ) :
    (forget₂ CommGrpCat GrpCat).map (X.unitsPresheaf.map i) u
      = Units.map (X.presheaf.map i).hom u :=
  rfl

namespace Hom

variable (f : X ⟶ Y) {V V' : Y.Opens} {U U' : X.Opens}

/-- The action of a morphism of schemes on unit sections: for `V : Y.Opens` and
`U ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ V`, the induced group homomorphism `Γ(Y, V)ˣ →* Γ(X, U)ˣ`. This is the
unit-group analogue of `Scheme.Hom.appLE` and is treated as a suffix in lemma names. -/
def unitsAppLE (f : X.Hom Y) (V : Y.Opens) (U : X.Opens) (e : U ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ V) :
    Γ(Y, V)ˣ →* Γ(X, U)ˣ :=
  Units.map (f.appLE V U e).hom

@[simp]
lemma coe_unitsAppLE (e : U ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ V) (u : Γ(Y, V)ˣ) :
    (f.unitsAppLE V U e u : Γ(X, U)) = f.appLE V U e u :=
  rfl

/-- Restriction after pullback: the unit-level mirror of `Scheme.Hom.appLE_map`. -/
@[simp]
lemma unitsAppLE_map (e : U ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ V) (i : op U ⟶ op U') (u : Γ(Y, V)ˣ) :
    Units.map (X.presheaf.map i).hom (f.unitsAppLE V U e u)
      = f.unitsAppLE V U' (i.unop.le.trans e) u := by
  ext
  simp only [Units.coe_map, MonoidHom.coe_coe, coe_unitsAppLE]
  rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply, appLE_map]

/-- Pullback after restriction: the unit-level mirror of `Scheme.Hom.map_appLE`. -/
@[simp]
lemma map_unitsAppLE (e : U ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ V) (i : op V' ⟶ op V) (u : Γ(Y, V')ˣ) :
    f.unitsAppLE V U e (Units.map (Y.presheaf.map i).hom u)
      = f.unitsAppLE V' U (e.trans ((TopologicalSpace.Opens.map f.base).map i.unop).le) u := by
  ext
  simp only [Units.coe_map, MonoidHom.coe_coe, coe_unitsAppLE]
  rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply, map_appLE]

end Hom

/-- Pullback along a composite: the unit-level mirror of `Scheme.appLE_comp_appLE`. -/
@[simp]
lemma unitsAppLE_unitsAppLE (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) {W : Z.Opens} {V : Y.Opens}
    {U : X.Opens} (e₁ : V ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ W) (e₂ : U ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ V) (u : Γ(Z, W)ˣ) :
    f.unitsAppLE V U e₂ (g.unitsAppLE W V e₁ u)
      = (f ≫ g).unitsAppLE W U
          (e₂.trans ((TopologicalSpace.Opens.map f.base).map (homOfLE e₁)).le) u := by
  ext
  simp only [Hom.coe_unitsAppLE]
  rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply, Hom.appLE_comp_appLE]

/-- Pullback along the identity is restriction: the unit-level mirror of `Scheme.id_app`. -/
lemma id_unitsAppLE {U V : X.Opens} (e : U ≤ V) (u : Γ(X, V)ˣ) :
    (𝟙 X : X ⟶ X).unitsAppLE V U e u
      = Units.map (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE e).op).hom u :=
  rfl

end Scheme

end AlgebraicGeometry

Componentwise, the per-tile\n  localisation (Lemma~\\ref{lem:tile_section_localization}) exhibits \\(\\Gamma(D(g_j f), \\mathcal{F})\\) as\n  the localisation of \\(\\Gamma(D(g_j), \\mathcal{F})\\) at the powers of \\(f\\), and the per-overlap\n  localisation (Lemma~\\ref{lem:overlap_section_localization}) \u2014 the transport of\n  Lemma~\\ref{lem:tile_section_localization} along \\(D(g_j g_k) = D(g_j) \\cap D(g_k)\\) and\n  \\(D(g_j g_k f) = D(g_j f) \\cap D(g_k f)\\) \u2014 exhibits \\(\\Gamma(D(g_j g_k f), \\mathcal{F})\\) as the\n  localisation of \\(\\Gamma(D(g_j g_k), \\mathcal{F})\\). Since a finite product of localisation maps at the\n  same set is again a localisation, the product maps \\(b\\) and \\(c\\) are\n  \\(\\operatorname{IsLocalizedModule}\\) at the powers of \\(f\\).\n\n  Apply the abstract left-exact-ladder kernel comparison\n  Lemma~\\ref{lem:isLocalizedModule_of_exact} to this ladder, with \\(S = \\operatorname{powers} f\\), the\n  two left-exact rows, and the two localised right-hand verticals \\(b, c\\). It concludes that the left\n  vertical \\(\\rho_f : \\Gamma(X, \\mathcal{F}) \\to \\Gamma(D(f), \\mathcal{F})\\) is itself a localisation map\n  at the powers of \\(f\\); equivalently, its canonical lift \\(\\Gamma(X, \\mathcal{F})_f \\cong\n  \\Gamma(D(f), \\mathcal{F})\\) is an isomorphism. (The exactness of localisation,\n  Lemma~\\ref{lem:localized_module_map_exact_mathlib}, is the converse statement: it certifies that the\n  localised \\(X\\)-row is again left-exact, the consistency under which the kernel comparison operates.)\n\n  \\emph{Crucial non-circularity point.} The only ``sections-localise'' inputs are the per-tile\n  localisations (Lemma~\\ref{lem:tile_section_localization}), which live on the tiles\n  \\(\\mathcal{F}_{(g_j)}\\) and \\(\\mathcal{F}_{(g_j g_k)}\\). There \\(\\mathcal{F}\\) is associated to a\n  module \u2014 the tile is globally presented, hence \\(\\mathcal{F}_{(g)} \\cong \\widetilde{M_g}\\) (since\n  \\(\\widetilde{(-)}\\) preserves colimits), \\textbf{not} by computing \\(\\Gamma(D(g), -)\\) of an abstract\n  cokernel \u2014 and the localisation is given by\n  Lemma~\\ref{lem:section_isLocalizedModule_of_presentation} via the canonical section\n  equality \\(\\Gamma(\\mathcal{F}_{(g)}, V) = \\Gamma(\\mathcal{F}, \\iota(V))\\)\n  (Lemma~\\ref{lem:restrict_obj_mathlib}). The global statement for \\(\\mathcal{F}\\) is then recovered\n  from the tiles by the sheaf-axiom equalizer and the exactness of localisation, \\textbf{not} by\n  identifying \\(\\Gamma(X, \\mathcal{F})\\) with an abstract localised module of its restrictions. In\n  particular no instance of the keystone at the \\(g_j\\) is invoked, so the regress that an algebraic\n  span-cover descent on the global sections would create (reducing the keystone-at-\\(f\\) to the\n  keystone-at-\\(g_j\\), the same statement) is avoided.\n",

/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/.archon-horizon/blueprints/GR-Quot-Closure.json:4628:      "statement": "\\textit{Source: [Nitsure], \\S 1.}\n  Gluing the affine charts \\(\\{U^I\\}\\) (\\cref{def:gr_affine_chart}), one for each\n  of the \\(\\binom{r}{d}\\) subsets \\(I \\subseteq \\{1,\\dots,r\\}\\) of cardinality\n  \\(d\\), along the open subschemes \\(U^I_J \\subseteq U^I\\) via the transition\n  isomorphisms \\(\\theta_{I,J} : U^I_J \\xrightarrow{\\sim} U^J_I\\)\n  (\\cref{def:gr_transition}) -- which satisfy the cocycle condition\n  \\(\\theta_{I,K} = \\theta_{J,K} \\circ \\theta_{I,J}\\) and \\(\\theta_{I,I} = \\id\\)\n  of \\cref{lem:gr_cocycle} -- yields a scheme\n  \\[\n    \\mathrm{Gr}(r,d) \\longrightarrow \\Spec \\mathbb{Z}.\n  \\]\n  It is of finite type over \\(\\mathbb{Z}\\) (a finite gluing of finitely\n  generated \\(\\mathbb{Z}\\)-algebras), and under the gluing each \\(U^I\\) is an\n  open subscheme of \\(\\mathrm{Gr}(r,d)\\) with \\(U^I \\cap U^J = U^I_J\\).\n\n  \\emph{Construction of the glue datum.} The gluing is carried out through the\n  Mathlib vehicle for scheme gluing, a glue datum in the sense of a category of\n  schemes (the structure \\(\\mathtt{Scheme.GlueData}\\), extending the abstract\n  glue-datum interface). Its data are supplied as follows. The index set is the\n  set \\(J := \\{\\, I \\subseteq \\{1,\\dots,r\\} : \\#(I) = d \\,\\}\\) of size-\\(d\\)\n  subsets. The objects are the charts \\(U^I\\) (\\cref{def:gr_affine_chart}); the\n  pairwise overlaps are the schemes \\(U^I_J\\) (\\cref{def:gr_chart_overlap}); the\n  inclusions \\(f_{I,J} : U^I_J \\to U^I\\) are the open immersions\n  \\(\\cref{def:gr_chart_incl}\\) (open immersions by\n  \\cref{lem:gr_chartIncl_isOpenImmersion}, in particular monomorphisms), with the\n  identity field \\(f_{\\mathrm{id}}\\) supplied by\n  \\cref{lem:gr_chartIncl_self_isIso}; the transition isomorphisms\n  \\(t_{I,J} : U^I_J \\to U^J_I\\) are the scheme-level transitions\n  \\(\\cref{def:gr_chart_transition}\\), with identity field \\(t_{\\mathrm{id}}\\)\n  supplied by \\cref{lem:gr_chartTransition_self}.\n\n  The triple-overlap field \\(t'\\) and its first coherence obligation are supplied\n  by the two preceding results. The field itself is the morphism\n  \\(t'_{I,J,K} : U^I_J \\times_{U^I} U^I_K \\to U^J_K \\times_{U^J} U^J_I\\) of\n  \\cref{def:gr_chart_transition'}, and the compatibility field\n  \\(t_{\\mathrm{fac}}\\) -- that \\(t'\\) is compatible with the projections to the\n  charts -- is \\cref{lem:gr_chartTransition'_fac}, which reduces (both fibre\n  products being affine) to the ring identity\n  \\cref{lem:gr_chartTransition'_ringIdentity} via the leg lemmas\n  \\cref{lem:gr_awayPullbackIso_inv_fst} and \\cref{lem:gr_awayPullbackIso_inv_snd}.\n\n  \\emph{Cocycle field.} The \\(t'\\)-cocycle coherence\n  \\(t'_{I,J,K} \\circ t'_{J,K,I} \\circ t'_{K,I,J} = \\mathrm{id}\\)\n  follows from \\cref{lem:gr_chartTransition'_cocycle} via the ring identity\n  \\cref{lem:gr_cocycle_phi_id}. With this field in hand the glue datum is\n  complete: it is the structure \\(\\mathtt{Scheme.GlueData}\\) with\n  \\(U := \\texttt{affineChart}\\) (\\cref{def:gr_affine_chart}),\n  \\(V := \\texttt{chartOverlap}\\) (\\cref{def:gr_chart_overlap}),\n  \\(f := \\texttt{chartIncl}\\) (\\cref{def:gr_chart_incl}),\n  \\(t := \\texttt{chartTransition}\\) (\\cref{def:gr_chart_transition}),\n  \\(t_{\\mathrm{id}} := \\texttt{chartTransition\\_self}\\)\n  (\\cref{lem:gr_chartTransition_self}),\n  \\(t' := \\texttt{chartTransition'}\\) (\\cref{def:gr_chart_transition'}),\n  \\(t_{\\mathrm{fac}} := \\texttt{chartTransition'\\_fac}\\)\n  (\\cref{lem:gr_chartTransition'_fac}), and the cocycle field above. The glued\n  scheme \\(\\mathrm{Gr}(r,d)\\) is then the colimit\n  \\((\\text{glue datum}).\\mathrm{glued}\\) produced by the gluing machine.\n\n  Moreover \\(\\mathrm{Gr}(r,d) \\to \\Spec \\mathbb{Z}\\) is \\emph{smooth of relative\n  dimension \\(d(r-d)\\)}. As\n  the property may be checked on an open cover of the source, the conclusion\n  follows.",

/-- **Constructor congruence for the cocycle datum**: two data with the same cover data
and pointwise-equal transition units are equal (the cocycle laws are proofs). This is
the shape of the RE-5 descent certificate after the cover-data components have been
substituted. -/
lemma BasicOpenCocycleDatum.ext_units {cov : BasicOpenCoverData C R π}
    {u₁ u₂ : ∀ i j : cov.index, Γ(relCurve C R, cov.pieces i ⊓ cov.pieces j)ˣ}
    {c₁ : Scheme.IsGluingCocycle cov.pieces u₁} {c₂ : Scheme.IsGluingCocycle cov.pieces u₂}
    (h : ∀ i j, u₁ i j = u₂ i j) :
    (⟨cov, u₁, c₁⟩ : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C R π) = ⟨cov, u₂, c₂⟩ := by
  obtain rfl : u₁ = u₂ := funext fun i => funext fun j => h i j
  rfl

   238	lemma baseChange_inf_le_preimage (i j : D.index) :
   239	    (D.baseChange B').pieces i ⊓ (D.baseChange B').pieces j ≤
   240	      relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ (D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j) := by
   241	  rw [Scheme.Hom.preimage_inf]
   242	  exact inf_le_inf (D.baseChange_pieces_le_preimage B' i)
   243	    (D.baseChange_pieces_le_preimage B' j)
   244	
   245	/-- **The overlap comparison map**: sections on a double overlap of pieces compare to
   246	sections on the double overlap of the base-changed pieces, through `appLE` of the
   247	relative-curve comparison. -/
   248	noncomputable def overlapMap (i j : D.index) :
   249	    Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j) →+*
   250	      Γ(relCurve C B', (D.baseChange B').pieces i ⊓ (D.baseChange B').pieces j) :=
   251	  ((relCurveMap C B B').appLE (D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j)
   252	    ((D.baseChange B').pieces i ⊓ (D.baseChange B').pieces j)
   253	    (D.baseChange_inf_le_preimage B' i j)).hom
   254	
   255	end BasicOpenCoverData
   256	
   257	namespace BasicOpenCocycleDatum
   258	
   259	variable (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π)
   260	
   261	/-- **Base change of the pinned cocycle datum** along `B → B'` (stage (1d-ii), the
   262	datum half; the RE-5 descent/transport interface): generators, partition coefficients
   263	and transition units push forward through the relative-curve comparison; the cocycle
   264	identities are carried by ring-hom functoriality (`Scheme.Hom.appLE_resHom`). -/
   265	noncomputable def baseChange : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B' π where
   266	  toBasicOpenCoverData := D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange B'
   267	  unit i j := Units.map (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.overlapMap B' i j).toMonoidHom
   268	    (D.unit i j)
   269	  isGluingCocycle := by
   270	    constructor
   271	    · intro i
   272	      have h := D.isGluingCocycle.unit_self i
   273	      change (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.overlapMap B' i i)
   274	        ((D.unit i i : Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces i))) = 1
   275	      rw [h, map_one]
   276	    · intro i j l
   277	      -- the triple overlap of the base-changed pieces sits below the preimage of the
   278	      -- triple overlap
   279	      have htriple : (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange B').pieces i ⊓
   280	            (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange B').pieces j ⊓
   281	            (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange B').pieces l ≤
   282	          relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ (D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j ⊓ D.pieces l) := by
   283	        rw [Scheme.Hom.preimage_inf]
   284	        exact inf_le_inf (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange_inf_le_preimage B' i j)
   285	          (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange_pieces_le_preimage B' l)
   286	      have key := congrArg
   287	        (((relCurveMap C B B').appLE (D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j ⊓ D.pieces l)
   288	          ((D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange B').pieces i ⊓
   289	            (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange B').pieces j ⊓
   290	            (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange B').pieces l) htriple).hom)
   291	        (D.isGluingCocycle.mul_res i j l)
   292	      rw [map_mul] at key
   293	      have e₁ := (relCurveMap C B B').appLE_resHom
   294	        (inf_le_left : D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j ⊓ D.pieces l ≤ D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j)
   295	        (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange_inf_le_preimage B' i j) htriple
   296	        (inf_le_left : (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange B').pieces i ⊓
   297	          (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange B').pieces j ⊓
   298	          (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange B').pieces l ≤
   299	          (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange B').pieces i ⊓
   300	            (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange B').pieces j)
   301	        ((D.unit i j : Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j)))
   302	      have e₂ := (relCurveMap C B B').appLE_resHom
   303	        (gluedInclCoc D.pieces (D.pieces i) j l)
   304	        (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange_inf_le_preimage B' j l) htriple
   305	        (gluedInclCoc (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange B').pieces
   306	          ((D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange B').pieces i) j l)
   307	        ((D.unit j l : Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces j ⊓ D.pieces l)))
   308	      have e₃ := (relCurveMap C B B').appLE_resHom
   309	        (gluedInclSnd D.pieces (D.pieces i) j l)
   310	        (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange_inf_le_preimage B' i l) htriple
   311	        (gluedInclSnd (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange B').pieces
   312	          ((D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange B').pieces i) j l)
   313	        ((D.unit i l : Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces l)))
   314	      rw [← e₁, ← e₂, ← e₃] at key
   315	      simp only [Units.coe_map]
   316	      exact key
   317	
   318	@[simp]
   319	lemma baseChange_unit_coe (i j : D.index) :
   320	    (((D.baseChange B').unit i j :
   321	        Γ(relCurve C B',
   322	          (D.baseChange B').pieces i ⊓ (D.baseChange B').pieces j)ˣ) :
   323	      Γ(relCurve C B', (D.baseChange B').pieces i ⊓ (D.baseChange B').pieces j)) =
   324	      D.toBasicOpenCoverData.overlapMap B' i j
   325	        ((D.unit i j : Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j))) := rfl
   326	
   327	/-! ## The componentwise comparison of glued sections -/
   328	
   329	section SectionsMap
   330	
   331	variable {W : (relCurve C B).Opens} {W' : (relCurve C B').Opens}
   332	
   333	/-- The component opens of the comparison sit below the preimages of the component
   334	opens. -/
   335	lemma sectionsMap_component_le (hW' : W' ≤ relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ W) (j : D.index) :
   336	    W' ⊓ (D.baseChange B').pieces j ≤ relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ (W ⊓ D.pieces j) := by
   337	  rw [Scheme.Hom.preimage_inf]
   338	  exact inf_le_inf hW' (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange_pieces_le_preimage B' j)
   339	
   340	/-- **The componentwise comparison of glued sections** along `B → B'`: apply `appLE` of
   341	the relative-curve comparison to every component. Matching is carried by
   342	`Scheme.Hom.appLE_resHom` and the base-changed units. -/
   343	noncomputable def sectionsMap (hW' : W' ≤ relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ W)
   344	    (s : ↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit W)) :
   345	    ↥(gluedSubmodule B' (D.baseChange B').pieces (D.baseChange B').unit W') := by
   346	  refine ⟨fun j => ((relCurveMap C B B').appLE (W ⊓ D.pieces j)
   347	    (W' ⊓ (D.baseChange B').pieces j) (D.sectionsMap_component_le B' hW' j)).hom
   348	    (s.val j), ?_⟩
   349	  intro i j
   350	  have hdouble : W' ⊓ (D.baseChange B').pieces i ⊓ (D.baseChange B').pieces j ≤
   351	      relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ (W ⊓ D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j) := by
   352	    rw [Scheme.Hom.preimage_inf]
   353	    exact inf_le_inf (D.sectionsMap_component_le B' hW' i)
   354	      (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange_pieces_le_preimage B' j)
   355	  have key := congrArg
   356	    (((relCurveMap C B B').appLE (W ⊓ D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j)
   357	      (W' ⊓ (D.baseChange B').pieces i ⊓ (D.baseChange B').pieces j) hdouble).hom)
   358	    ((mem_gluedSubmodule_iff B D.pieces D.unit
   359	      (s.val : ∀ l : D.index, Γ(relCurve C B, W ⊓ D.pieces l))).mp s.property i j)
   360	  rw [map_mul] at key
   361	  have e₁ := (relCurveMap C B B').appLE_resHom
   362	    (inf_le_left : W ⊓ D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j ≤ W ⊓ D.pieces i)
   363	    (D.sectionsMap_component_le B' hW' i) hdouble
   364	    (inf_le_left : W' ⊓ (D.baseChange B').pieces i ⊓ (D.baseChange B').pieces j ≤
   365	      W' ⊓ (D.baseChange B').pieces i) (s.val i)
   366	  have e₂ := (relCurveMap C B B').appLE_resHom
   367	    (gluedInclCoc D.pieces W i j)
   368	    (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange_inf_le_preimage B' i j) hdouble
   369	    (gluedInclCoc (D.baseChange B').pieces W' i j)
   370	    ((D.unit i j : Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j)))
   371	  have e₃ := (relCurveMap C B B').appLE_resHom
   372	    (gluedInclSnd D.pieces W i j)
   373	    (D.sectionsMap_component_le B' hW' j) hdouble
   374	    (gluedInclSnd (D.baseChange B').pieces W' i j) (s.val j)
   375	  rw [← e₁, ← e₂, ← e₃] at key
   376	  exact key
   377	
   378	@[simp]
   379	lemma sectionsMap_coe (hW' : W' ≤ relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ W)
   380	    (s : ↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit W)) (j : D.index) :
   381	    (D.sectionsMap B' hW' s).val j =
   382	      ((relCurveMap C B B').appLE (W ⊓ D.pieces j)
   383	        (W' ⊓ (D.baseChange B').pieces j)
   384	        (D.sectionsMap_component_le B' hW' j)).hom (s.val j) := rfl
   385	
   386	/-- The comparison of glued sections is additive. -/
   387	lemma sectionsMap_add (hW' : W' ≤ relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ W)
   388	    (s t : ↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit W)) :
   389	    D.sectionsMap B' hW' (s + t) = D.sectionsMap B' hW' s + D.sectionsMap B' hW' t := by
   390	  refine Subtype.ext (funext fun j => ?_)
   391	  have hst : (s + t).val j = s.val j + t.val j := rfl
   392	  have hst' : (D.sectionsMap B' hW' s + D.sectionsMap B' hW' t).val j =
   393	      (D.sectionsMap B' hW' s).val j + (D.sectionsMap B' hW' t).val j := rfl
   394	  rw [hst', sectionsMap_coe, sectionsMap_coe, sectionsMap_coe, hst, map_add]
   395	
   396	/-- **Semilinearity of the comparison of glued sections**: it intertwines the
   397	coefficient actions along `algebraMap B B'`. -/
   398	lemma sectionsMap_smul (hW' : W' ≤ relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ W) (b : B)
   399	    (s : ↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit W)) :
   400	    D.sectionsMap B' hW' (b • s) = algebraMap B B' b • D.sectionsMap B' hW' s := by
   401	  refine Subtype.ext (funext fun j => ?_)
   402	  have hbs : ((b • s : ↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit W))).val j = b • s.val j := rfl
   403	  have hbs' : ((algebraMap B B' b • D.sectionsMap B' hW' s :
   404	      ↥(gluedSubmodule B' (D.baseChange B').pieces (D.baseChange B').unit W'))).val j =
   405	      algebraMap B B' b • (D.sectionsMap B' hW' s).val j := rfl
   406	  rw [hbs', sectionsMap_coe, sectionsMap_coe, hbs, Scheme.overModule_smul_def,
   407	    Scheme.overModule_smul_def, map_mul]
   408	  congr 1
   409	  exact relCurveMap_appLE_overAlgebraMap C B B' _ b
   410	
   411	/-- The comparison of glued sections commutes with restriction. -/
   412	lemma gluedRes_sectionsMap {V' V : (relCurve C B).Opens} (hV'V : V' ≤ V)
   413	    {P' P : (relCurve C B').Opens} (hP : P ≤ relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ V)
   414	    (hP' : P' ≤ relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ V') (hPP : P' ≤ P)
   415	    (s : ↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit V)) :
   416	    gluedRes B' (D.baseChange B').pieces (D.baseChange B').unit hPP
   417	        (D.sectionsMap B' hP s) =
   418	      D.sectionsMap B' hP' (gluedRes B D.pieces D.unit hV'V s) := by
   419	  refine Subtype.ext (funext fun j => ?_)
   420	  rw [gluedRes_coe, sectionsMap_coe, sectionsMap_coe, gluedRes_coe]
   421	  exact (relCurveMap C B B').appLE_resHom
   422	    (inf_le_inf_right (D.pieces j) hV'V) (D.sectionsMap_component_le B' hP j)
   423	    (D.sectionsMap_component_le B' hP' j)
   424	    (inf_le_inf_right ((D.baseChange B').pieces j) hPP) (s.val j)
   425	
   426	/-- **The comparison intertwines the piece trivializations with `appLE`**: on an open
   427	below a piece, trivializing the compared section is `appLE` of the trivialized
   428	section. -/
   429	lemma gluedTriv_sectionsMap (hW' : W' ≤ relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ W) {j : D.index}
   430	    (hWj : W ≤ D.pieces j) (hW'j : W' ≤ (D.baseChange B').pieces j)

cocycle datum over an arbitrary commutative `k`-algebra `B` descends to a finitely
generated `k`-subalgebra `B₀ ⊆ B` — there is a datum over `B₀` whose base change

verbatim (`descentRigidEngine`).
